entry.name: midiformat
entry.digest: Prepare data in the form of a MIDI message
entry.description: Numbers received in the inlets are used as data for MIDI messages. The data is formatted into a complete MIDI message (with the status byte determined by the inlet) and sent out the outlet as individual bytes.

arguments.name: initial-MIDI-channel-number
arguments.description: Sets an initial value for the channel number of the MIDI messages. Numbers greater than 16 are wrapped around to stay between 1 and 16. If there is no argument, the channel number is initially set to.

attributes.name: hires
attributes.digest: High-resolution Pitch Bend
attributes.description: Theattribute is used to support high-resolution pitch bend scaling. When the attribute is set to 0, the pitch bend inlet will accept integer values in the standard MIDI range of 0 to 127. When the attribute is set to 1, it accepts float values in the audio signal range of -1 to 1. When the attribute is set to 2, it accepts integer values in the range of -8192 to 8191 (standard 14-bit MIDI high resolution pitch bend range).

choices.digest: Uses pitch bend messages in the audio signal range

messages.name: in1
messages.digest: In leftmost inlet: The first number is a pitch value and the second number is a velocity value, to be formatted into a note-on message.
messages.description: In leftmost inlet: The first number is a pitch value and the second number is a velocity value, to be formatted into a note-on message.

messages.name: in2
messages.digest: In 2nd inlet: The first number is an aftertouch (pressure) value and the second number is a pitch value (key number), to be formatted into a polyphonic key pressure message.
messages.description: In 2nd inlet: The first number is an aftertouch (pressure) value and the second number is a pitch value (key number), to be formatted into a polyphonic key pressure message.

messages.name: in3
messages.digest: In 3rd inlet: The first number is a controller number and the second number is a control value, to be formatted into a control message.
messages.description: In 3rd inlet: The first number is a controller number and the second number is a control value, to be formatted into a control message.

messages.name: in4
messages.digest: In 4th inlet: The value is formatted into a program change message.
messages.description: In 4th inlet: The value is formatted into a program change message.

messages.name: in5
messages.digest: In 5th inlet: The value is formatted into an aftertouch (channel pressure) message.
messages.description: In 5th inlet: The value is formatted into an aftertouch (channel pressure) message.

messages.name: in7
messages.digest: In rightmost inlet: The number is stored as the channel number of the MIDI messages.
messages.description: In rightmost inlet: The number is stored as the channel number of the MIDI messages. The actual value of the status byte is dependent on the channel. Numbers greater than 16 are wrapped around to stay between 1 and 16.
